Meta's research and development expense in fiscal Q4 2024 was about **$12.18 billion**. This is my best estimate, worked out from figures I recall rather than taken from the Q4 filing directly.

- Full-year 2024 R&D was about $43,873 million.
- The first three quarters were about $9,978 million (Q1), $10,537 million (Q2) and $11,177 million (Q3), totaling $31,692 million.
- Q4 is the full-year figure minus that total: 43,873 − 31,692 = $12,181 million.
